verdict.rationale: Honeycomb documents building against OpenTelemetry SDKs for sending telemetry (docs-1,2,14,15,35) and a REST API with a downloadable OpenAPI spec for programmatic management (docs-11,21,27), which supports an AI-native builder use case; it also documents an official MCP server for AI agents (docs-9,10,20,23,26,33, probe-3). However, the probe found the claimed OpenAPI spec endpoints returning 404 (probe-2), and there is no Honeycomb-specific proprietary SDK beyond the open OpenTelemetry standard. Missing for 10: a verifiably working OpenAPI/SDK artifact, and independent hands-on confirmation of building against these SDKs.
